description.value: Jo's Italian Deli is a family-owned Italian deli and restaurant on Main Street serving sliced-to-order sandwiches on homemade bread, fresh pasta with scratch-made sauces, espresso drinks, and imported Italian grocery items. The brand originated in Chilliwack in 2018 and has since grown to several Lower Mainland locations, each aiming to be a casual neighbourhood staple. The Main St location is a newer addition, opened in 2026, with online ordering and delivery available.
